newsitem.title: INDIA: RESEARCH ALERT-UBS 'hold' on India Essar.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-UBS 'hold' on India Essar.

text.p: UBS Global Research said on Thursday it recommended a 'hold' on shares of Indian steel maker Essar Steel Ltd despite the firm's encouraging performance on the operational front.
"The recent outperformance is mainly on the back of an extremely weak performance over two years," it said.

It said sentiment on the stock was damaged by the enabling approvals taken at a recent annual general meeting to raise fresh funds through an issue of non-voting shares upto 25 percent of the issued capital and a $200 million overseas issue.
"The ability to raise fresh equity in the near-term remains restricted," UBS said.
"We believe the factors that will trigger outperformance - recovery in hot rolled coil (HR) prices and sucfessful completion of the restructuring programme -- are still distant."

Essar has initiated a restructuring plan by proposing to sell some assets. "We believe that the timeframe for completion of this restructuring is yet uncertain and the company may need to raise funds through expensive debt to meet short-term funds."
UBS said the hot rolled steel market was plagued by oversupply. "We see supply outpacing demand in the medium-term which will put pressure on domestic HR prices."

"Essar Steel is better placed than TISCO on four fronts -- better quality, lower operating costs due to freight advantages, tie-ups with downstream cold rolling mills to buy Essar's material and advantageous location for exports."
Although volume growth is expected to keep Essar in black, it may not be sufficient reason to buy the share, it said.
"While the company's performance on the operational front is encouraging, the financial position is tentative," it said.
